games.name: Dicebound
games.description: Build a deck of dice, place them on your board and merge matching dice to power them up while waves of monsters march down the path. Every merge is a gamble: the new dice is stronger, but which dice you get is up to chance.
features: Collect and upgrade dozens of dice, each with its own ability
Play solo or team up with a friend in online co-op
Shape each run with cards, bosses and a mastery tree
Daily quests and monthly events with their own rewards
games.art_alt: Dicebound title screen: mossy stone dice beside a forest path
